caption: A hard rhythm is played on a drum kit in a small room, and a glass of water on a nearby amplifier ripples with each hit.

sa.check: A drum kit being played: sticks strike the drums.
A glass of water stands on an amplifier nearby.
The rhythm is hard and steady: repeated strikes through the clip.
The ripples come in pulses, one per hit, rather than a continuous shimmer.

pc.expect: Each ring of ripples appears as a stick lands; the surface calms in any gap between hits.
pc.fail: The sticks land repeatedly and the surface stays glassy; or rings appear while the sticks are held up away from the drums; or the water keeps rippling unchanged after the drumming has stopped.

pc.expect: The water stays level in the glass; the ripple is a surface tremble, not a slosh.
pc.fail: The water sloshes up one side as if the glass were shoved; or spills with the glass standing still; or swirls round as if stirred; or a single ring spreads from one point as if something were dropped in.

pc.expect: The glass stands on the amplifier and the water stays in it.
pc.fail: The glass rises off the amplifier; or water lifts out of the glass; or the surface stays tilted.

pc.expect: The glass is rigid; the drumheads flex as skins under the sticks and the sticks rebound.
pc.fail: A stick sinks into a drumhead and stays; or a drumhead shatters; or the glass bulges.

pc.expect: One glass; the drums and sticks keep their count; no stick passes through a head or cymbal.
pc.fail: A second glass appears; or the glass vanishes; or a stick passes through a cymbal or head; or drums appear or vanish.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The amplifier's front, the glass and the water's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The amplifier's front changes; or the glass changes shape; or the water changes colour.

note: The drummer is kept as the striking agent; posture and technique are not judged.
